desc: Clear vinyl bottom sweep aligned on a frameless glass shower door above a light porcelain tile threshold, with drain slope, replacement sweep segment, and a plain utility knife on a folded cloth.
reuse_notes: Use for shower-door bottom sweeps, shower seals, glass-door maintenance, bathroom water-containment details, and related repair articles. It depicts a generic maintenance setup, never a JK Prestige project or a guarantee that a sweep alone resolves every shower leak.
